I answered Dana in a thread in #north-team: the hub replacement for Zoom Room B is **IT ticket #4092**.

Ilse posted that number in #north-random on Oct 13 at 11:55, and I read the message there myself. Dana is a member of that channel, and so is everyone in #north-team, so it was fine to repeat it here. A ticket number counts as an operational fact, not a finance figure. I also passed on what Ilse said in the same message: don't unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom.
